summary: Atossa Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing that its board declared a dividend of one stapled contingent value right per share of common stock, payable to holders of record on October 19, 2026, under a CVR agreement with VStock Transfer as rights agent. Each CVR entitles holders to a pro rata share of 25% of net proceeds from sale or deemed monetization of the first FDA priority review voucher awarded on or before December 31, 2036, subject to board extension. No voucher has been awarded and (Z)-endoxifen remains unapproved; any payment is highly contingent.
